title: Exception for Members Appointed Before Finance Act 2017

content.scenario: Rajesh was appointed as a member of the National Commission immediately before the commencement of section 177 of the Finance Act, 2017. He wants to know which Act will govern his tenure.
content.outcome: Rajesh will continue to be governed by the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 1986, as if the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 had not come into force.

user_queries: Which Act governs members appointed before Finance Act 2017?
What are the rules for members appointed before 2017?
How does the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 affect existing members?
